channel.name: crepes-and-crits-cafe☕🐈
channel.topic: Run by Eliot, an immigrant human, and staffed with animals, the crepes and crits cafe is a popular hangout spot for the young children with animal features who sleep in the parks of ferrytown.

content: Three days after the altercations with redcoats, the cafe is still closed. The only sign of life is animals going to and from the employee entrance in the back.

A week after the altercation, Eliot finally opens the door again of the cafe. Everything seems to be back to normal, Eliot is his polite and confident self once more and is happy to serve his customers.
A small piece of paper appears in Eliot's hands out of nowhere. It has his name on the front in a light orange text and a wax seal on the back with the design of a footprint.
Eliot blinks twice at the paper before turning it over and breaking the seal.

The letter inside has directions to <#875137859592531978> and has, in a fancy writing: ||"There are matters here I think you would find important to at least look over. There is no physical danger though there are quite a few people. Even so, I still believe you should come.||
||-Demetrius"||
Eliot's grip on the note tightens as he reads it then begins to make some preparations to leave the cafe, including writing a couple notes of his own. His hands fidgeting all the while.

Eliot speaks with Willow briefly as he tucks the notes into his pocket. 

Willow coos and climbs up Eliot and lays over his shoulder. 

Eliot leaves the cafè for <#875137859592531978> .
Eliot returns from his trek outside and collapses into a chair, and allows Willow to run the cafe while he... processes.

<@363458590461132800> Hello! Your long rest is over now, have a great new day in Empire City!
Remember to call `!game lr` to get your rechargeable abilities from Avrae.
A tall fey with orange-white eyes, short green hair, and glowing white antlers knocks on the door of the cafe. He is accompanied by Ferrah.
( <@!363458590461132800> i'll be a little sporadic but i'm down to do this scene starting now)
(Okie dokie. I'm about to leave for work but I'm down just gotta drive first)

The door of the cafe opens with a small chime and Eliot turns to greet the pair and his words catch getting a brief 'deer in headlights' look before finishing with his current customer and approaching them. "Good afternoon." Eliot gives a slight bow to each of them.
Demetrius bows and Ferrah curtsys. "As requested." Demetrius smiles. "May we come in?"
"Of course. Of course. Absolutely. My apologies." Eliot bows to both of them again before leading them to an empty table. "Can I get either of you anything?"
"Whatever you recommend, please!" Beams Ferrah, taking a seat. Her skin is a pale green with pink accents.
Eliot nods and notes it down before departing to make Ferrah a beverage and treat.
Demetrius nods. "Some tea would be wonderful, Eliot."

Eliot returns and sets an iced beverage  of swirling colors resembling the night sky along with a small tray of macaroons before Ferrah, and a cup of tea before Demetrius. 

Eliot's presentation is confident, but his gaze drifts nervously to the tea.
"please, sit down." Demetrius says, motioning to a third chair at the table you're sure was only set for two.
"Yes sir." Eliot sits down with only the briefest hesitantion as he looks across the cafe to check on his other patrons.
Matteo, Willow, and Despo seen to be handling them well enough
"Now then, why don't you walk me through what we can do for you?" Demetrius smiles as Ferrah pleasantly eats and drinks.

Eliot takes a deep breath before his expression gets a bit sterner and more business like as he focuses his attention towards Demetrius. "Mister Demetrius, sir. We talked over it briefly when I first decided to re open the cafe after changing the name to Crepes and Crits Café. The possibility of giving my employees a voice of thier own in addition to other benefits. It is time that I would like to see this come to fruition. Specifically speaking I would like to nominate Willow to be Awakened. Of my four full time employees she shows the most promise and has been a large help both here in the business, and personally after... all that transpired over the past few weeks. She's also taken a keen interest in helping everything run smoothly. Matteo and Despo despite working here longer are both still to immature and I don't fault them for it, they are wonderful boys and do their jobs wonderfully, but I don't believe they are responsible enough for what I would be asking of them. That and they are a package deal, I personally would not do one without the other. Clementine on the other hand is responsible enough to handle the task, but her personality is not suited for running the cafe. Which she's shown no interest in doing anyways. She's been quite clear she much prefers to help with the baking in the back, which she is quite magnificent at and has even taught myself a thing or two back there."
He nods and looks to Ferrah, who nods happily. "Could I talk to Willow as well, please?" Demetrius asks
Eliot nods before standing up.  "Would you like me to stay?"
He nods.

Eliot gives a bow to each of them before going to talk with Willow briefly. Eliot then finishes the order she was working on as the red panda makes her way to the table and climbs up into the empty chair.

Eliot returns shortly after.
There is a fourth chair for Eliot to sit in, and Demetrius nods before turning to Willow. "Are you aware of what we are discussing at the moment, Willow?" (You'll control her responses for this bit)

Willow: The red panda stands in her seat and props her forepaws on the edge of the table 🐾 ||"I do not. Eliot said it would be important  and life changing, but did want to say more as it was your decision to make not his own."|| 🐾
"Eliot, would you like to tell her or should I?" Demetrius asks

Eliot: "You sir. If its no bother.  You know the intricacies more than me. I just have a basic understanding." Eliot says from his chair.

Willow: Her head flips between Demetrius and Eliot. 🐾 ||"Have I done something wrong?"|| 🐾 

Eliot: He simply shakes his head and gives her a reassuring smile.
Demetrius smiles at Willow. "Are you familiar with the concept of awakening?"
Willow's head cocks to one side as her head shakes back and forth,  a quizzical expression on her face.

"I figured not." Demetrius says. "Awakening is the process by which an animal or plant gains a greater degree of intelligence. I assume by this point of working with Eliot you've come to realize that, to some degree, there are things he and others are capable of that you and the other employees are not."
Willow: 🐾 ||"Some. I make do. Try to at least."|| 🐾
He nods. "Eliot brought us here because he'd like to have you awakened, should you be willing. Would you want that?"

Willow: The red panda plops down into her seat to think for a bit before popping back up. 🐾 ||I'm not sure... it sounds like a lot. Is.. is there anyone who's done it already?  Like from my side?"|| 🐾

Demetrius nods. "I don't have anyone you could speak with right now, but I can say in my many years I have encountered several awakened creatures. Most enjoy it, and all tend to agree there are more things they can do, but some regret the increased knowledge and sense of responsibility. The choice is wholly up to you."
Willow plops back down again and looks out over the  cafe, then stands back up and nods 🐾 ||"I'll do it. I'll figure it out. I'll help others when it's thier time too. "|| 🐾
Demetrius nods and smiles, before looking to Eliot. "Do you want to do it now?"
Eliot: "What do you need Mr. Demetrius?"

"For now, nothing more than your assurance. I know you're good for it." He chuckles lightly. "And besides, the process will take a while. Plenty of time to work out an arrangement." He looks to Willow. "Does that sound alright to the both of you?"
Eliot and Willow both look to each other then back to Demetrius and nod in agreement.
He smiles. "Willow, can you be available for the next 8 hours? Ferrah will need to have you on hand."

Willow: The red panda looks to Eliot.

Eliot: "You're all set we can get by. You three managed to keep this place going and forced me to take a day off. We'll be fine."

Willow: She nods to Eliot, then to Demetrius, before looking at Ferrah expectantly.
(Arcania bot out here over reacting. Chill. )

Ferrah smiles and offers a hand, leading Willow around back. Demetrius turns to Eliot. "We should talk as well, please come with me. And don't worry about keeping up with all the orders. I'll make sure they've not overloaded."
"Yes sir." Eliot nods. "Here or...?" He eyes the door nervously.
"Someplace nearby outside but quite comfortable you I hope."
Eliot nods. "I'll be right there. I'm going  to let Matteo and Despo know I'm stepping out. And grabbing a treat for the kids. Just incase."
(the kid?)
(My b. Sutri's kids)
Demetrius nods and waits by the door.

<@260820438026813440> Timer started for 480 minutes. You'll get a ping when the time's up.
Eliot goes and speaks to Matteo and Despo before fetching a set of donut holes and returning to Demetrius. "I'm ready now Mr. Demetrius."
Demetrius nods and leads Eliot outside.
He heads to a nearby tree and places a palm that turns into a radiant hoof as it touches the trunk. "Please, step inside."
Eliot steps into the tree trunk without a word, his hand fidgeting lightly.
As you do you find yourself in a small room, the walls carved with wood. There is a table and two chairs and a pair of saucers and a pot of tea.
Eliot stands by one of the chairs but doesn't take a seat. His hand does stop shaking however.
"Please, sit. Tea?" Demetrius asks as he sits himself.
"Yes please sir." Eliot says as he sits down.
Demetrius smiles and pours you a cup. "Now then, let us get down to business." He takes a so and smiles.
Eliot thanks Demetrius quietly and nods before taking a sip. "What is it you wanted to discuss sir?"
The tea is excellent. "The price of awakening, dear Eliot."
Eliot nods soberly and sips his tea again taking a moment to take in the scent. "Yes sir."
"Your tea has been better, but I think we both know it is not yet up standards. I dearly hope Willow's change will enable you to achieve your goal faster." He eyes you over his cup, smiling warmly.
"I do believe it will be beneficial. It will provide me more time on growing plants and attempting new blends." Eliot elaborates after a moment to reflect and setting his unfinished tea down quietly.
Demetrius nods. "How much time is left before your deadline, again?" (Totally up to you to decide this, I trust you to choose something reasonable.)
"Twenty four days until the anniversary of the original cafe opening. Twenty four days to get things right." Eliot says his volume dipping dipping on the second phrase.
He nods once again. "Though tasters often have a sneak preview of special items, do they not?" He sips the tea gently. "And I'd hate for such a tragedy to happen on the day of were it to occur."

"Never sir!" Eliot says a bit too zealously, almost offended at the thought before recomposing himself. "The first taster is myself. Those I feel may be worthy of your exquisite pallette I set aside for when you come to the cafe. After today's batch I have four other contenders. Those that cannot compete I add to circulation for  those that are blessed with refined pallettes."
He nods slowly. "If not time, then what will you offer me in exchange for my assistance?"

"I..." Eliot starts then pauses to think deeply, his expression getting sterner. "I have time still. And I still think I can do it. So I'm not willing to offer something I'm not prepared to give just yet. I will more willing to negotiate in the coming future and I run out of options. In the meantime, if I fail to succeed on the task you've asked of me what do you desire of mine?"
(is this your making the decision that Eliot never knew what the cost was? Want to be clear)
(This is Eliot assuming Demetrius wants to up the ante as the pressure sets in.)

(gotcha)
(Apologies, but I'll have to continue this tomorrow)
(you have full permission to ignore the need for a long rest until I finish this)
<@260820438026813440> Your timer is done: Willow has now been awoken!
Demetrius nods. "I understand why you would think that, but no. With Willow's help I think your chances of succeeding are increased. I would like to make a seperate deal."
"I understand. I apologize for jumping to conclusions." Eliot looks down to the table.
"Quite alright my dear Eliot" he says, sipping the tea. "Now then, there are two options: either a small price and you pay for the cost of the gem needed to cast the spell, or a larger price."
Eliot frowns slightly, thinking. "If the smaller price is just for the gem, what is the larger price for?"

"The small price is in addition to the gem. You owe recompense for both its cost and the time and effort to cast the spell and arrange for Ferrah's time. Either your can pay the gold cost for the gem within the next few days and a smaller other price, or simply a larger price that covers both parts."
"Am I allowed to know the asking price for either of these? Or will I need to decide before knowing the cost?" Eliot asks before looking back up to Demetrius.
"I would be more than happy to negotiate a price for either that satisfies both of us."
"I did prepare the funds to cover the costs. That being said sir. I may be prepared for the larger cost. The cafe is everything I'd dreamed of and more."
He nods. "For a small cost, I think a valuable childhood memory would suffice. For the larger one... perhaps a few of your years and a memory, or perhaps the common tongue?"
"What kind of memory?" Eliot asks apprehensively.
"One that... has some skill to it." Demetrius says after a pause. (Mechanically you'd lose a background proficiency)

Eliot nods, mulling over the prospect. "I'm tempted to agree to the years, I'm simply human and those are quite finite. I'm not so young as to believe otherwise. That said, the past couple years, the past few weeks in particular. Give me pause. I don't want to offer something I can't give and..." Eliot fishes into his pocket and pulls out his two Drachmae, setting them down beside his cup of tea. "I don't intend to linger after my time is done. If I survive this war, the years are absolutely available. Until then, it feels to me I'd risk cheating you of something you'd be owed."
